overview.name: 21Shares Active Crypto ETF
overview.description: Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in Crypto Assets or in securities or other instruments that provide economic exposure to Crypto Assets or have economic characteristics that are substantially similar to Crypto Assets (“Crypto Asset-related investments”). The fund is non-diversified.
